interpretation.measurement: Trusted input to next/second rAF callback is a presentation opportunity, not rendered FPS, physical photon/pixel latency, scientific significance or an exact CPU-time measurement.
interpretation.firstPair: Selection P95 rose67.8 to84.6ms in the original25-static versus26-installed pair. This observed difference is retained and is not described as no-regression.
interpretation.counterbalanced: Same-source25-26-26-25 batches gave selection P95 85.8/132.2/75.8/79.1ms. B1 was slower and B2 did not repeat that difference. No batch or outlier was removed. The sequence alone neither proves stable code regression nor proves no regression or universal acceleration.
interpretation.cpu: Configured100us profiling is diagnosis only; it changes timing. New26 refresh attributed4.975ms inclusive across20 measured selections (arithmetic mean0.24875ms; largest observed window0.561ms), including overlapping translate3.325ms and current/selection/image-scan1.650ms. This does not support a material new refresh hotspot explaining the earlier tail difference. Existing selection-property/heatmap/baseSvg-clone costs appear in both versions. Program/idle labels do not identify OS contention or a specific layout cause.
interpretation.scope: One Windows device, sequential batches. Native installation/update/scientific computation/IME and private-photo acceptance are separate. No normal-latency claims may be derived from profiled action timestamps.
